title: Curious Urgency 51
author: bpatrick
body: Summer of comics comes to a close. We’ll see how my schedule pans out but I plan on updating at least once a week. Meanwhile, here’s some more Sheriff Chuck!

comments.author: steve
comments.text: I can’t wait to see what you have in store for this comic. Thanks for keeping them coming!

comments.author: T52
comments.text: Yay! Curious Urgency is my favorite! (Also, what’s going on with the guy in the bottom left of panel 7? Being savaged by a giant clam? Impractical radio helmet?) Love the amount of detail you put into your backgrounds.

comments.author: krystalversion
comments.text: I just found your site today and it’s wonderful. I’m going through and reading all your comics.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: You should let us know what your favorite comic is. It’s rather dull while b hasn’t been uploading new ones, so I’ll take your favorite as a recommended re-read. Welcome to akimbocomics krystal.

comments.author: Joshua
comments.text: I got linked through Subnormality, and I’m glad I was! I like a lot of your comics on here, especially ES&D and this one! I’ll be checking back on here to see how some of your unfinished work gets tied up. Keep up the good work!
